records.rule: net material -2 (before your move, -2 vs best line) at the end of Stockfish's line but the reply isn't a capture; key move Bd5+: discovered_attack
records.explanation: Bxg2 walked into a discovered attack: you end -2 in material. In Stockfish's lines, fxe6 (+5.6) keeps the material level; your Bxg2 (-0.3) gives up a bishop for a pawn. fxe6 takes the bishop on e6. Your Bxg2 takes the pawn on g2, moves the bishop on e4 out of attack and attacks the rook on h1; Stockfish answers Bd5+, which gives check and attacks the bishop on g2.
